title: Tell me about yourself
intro: When they say "Tell me about yourself", tell a short story: your role, what you do now, and what you want next.
introNative: जब interviewer कहें "Tell me about yourself", तो एक छोटी-सी कहानी बताइए: आपका role, अभी आप क्या करते हैं, और आगे आपका goal क्या है।

phrases.text: I'm a Java developer with three years of experience in building backend services.
phrases.native: मैं एक Java developer हूँ, और मेरे पास backend services बनाने का तीन साल का experience है।
phrases.note: Start with your role and experience, not your name and native place.

phrases.text: Currently, I work at Infosys in Chennai on a banking project.
phrases.native: फ़िलहाल मेरा काम चेन्नई में Infosys में, एक banking project पर है।
phrases.note: Use the simple present "I work" for your current job.

phrases.text: I mainly work with Spring Boot, microservices and AWS.
phrases.native: मेरा काम ज़्यादातर Spring Boot, microservices और AWS पर होता है।
phrases.note: Name two or three key skills that match the job description.

phrases.text: I graduated in computer science from Anna University in 2021.
phrases.native: मैंने 2021 में Anna University से computer science में graduation किया।
phrases.note: Say "graduated", never "passed out", which means fainted.

phrases.text: Now I'm looking to grow into a senior role with more design work.
phrases.native: अब मेरा goal है एक ऐसे senior role में grow करना, जिसमें design का काम ज़्यादा हो।
phrases.note: End with what you want next; it leads into "Why this job?"

steps.prompt: The interviewer says: "Tell me about yourself." Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: Interviewer कहते हैं: "Tell me about yourself." कौन सा जवाब सबसे अच्छा है?
options: Myself Karthik, my native is Madurai, my father is a farmer.
I'm a Java developer with three years of experience in building backend services.
I am Karthik. I have done B.E. and I am a hard worker.
steps.answer: I'm a Java developer with three years of experience in building backend services.
steps.explanation: Start with your professional identity; family details and native place are not needed.
steps.explanationNative: अपनी professional पहचान से शुरू कीजिए; family की बातें और आप कहाँ के रहने वाले हैं, यह बताने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।

steps.promptNative: फ़िलहाल मेरा काम चेन्नई में Infosys में, एक banking project पर है।
steps.answer: Currently, I work at Infosys in Chennai on a banking project.

steps.audioText: I'm a Java developer with three years of experience in building backend services.
options: I was a Java developer for three years, building backend services.
I'm a Java developer with three years of experience in building backend services.
I'm a Java developer with two years of experience in building backend services.
steps.answer: I'm a Java developer with three years of experience in building backend services.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Myself Priya, and I am having 3 years experience.
options: Myself Priya, and I am having 3 years experience.
I'm Priya, and I have three years of experience.
Myself Priya, and I have 3 years experience.
I am Priya, and I am having three years of experience.
steps.answer: I'm Priya, and I have three years of experience.
steps.explanation: Say "I'm Priya", not "Myself Priya", and "I have three years of experience", not "I am having".
steps.explanationNative: "Myself Priya" नहीं, "I'm Priya" कहिए; और "I am having" नहीं, "I have three years of experience" कहिए।

steps.prompt: You've finished your introduction. How do you end it? Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: आपने अपना introduction पूरा कर लिया है। अब इसे कैसे खत्म करेंगे? कौन सा जवाब सबसे अच्छा है?
options: That's all about me.
I am ready for any role, any company.
Now I'm looking to grow into a senior role with more design work.
steps.answer: Now I'm looking to grow into a senior role with more design work.
steps.explanation: End with your next goal, so the interviewer knows why you're here.
steps.explanationNative: अपने अगले goal के साथ खत्म कीजिए, ताकि interviewer को समझ आए कि आप यहाँ किसलिए हैं।

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: I passed out in 2021 from Anna University.
options: I passed out in 2021 from Anna University.
I graduated from Anna University in 2021.
I passed out from Anna University in 2021 itself.
I was passed out from Anna University in 2021.
steps.answer: I graduated from Anna University in 2021.
steps.explanation: "Passed out" means fainted; to talk about finishing your degree, say "I graduated".
steps.explanationNative: "Passed out" का मतलब है बेहोश हो जाना; degree पूरी करने की बात के लिए "I graduated" कहिए।

steps.promptNative: मेरा काम ज़्यादातर Spring Boot, microservices और AWS पर होता है।
steps.answer: I mainly work with Spring Boot, microservices and AWS.

steps.audioText: I graduated in computer science from Anna University in 2021.
options: I graduated in computer science from Anna University in 2020.
I studied computer science at Anna University until 2021.
I graduated in computer science from Anna University in 2021.
steps.answer: I graduated in computer science from Anna University in 2021.

steps.prompt: Answer "Tell me about yourself" out loud about your real background in 4–5 sentences: your role and experience, your current company, key skills, and what you want next.
steps.promptNative: "Tell me about yourself" का जवाब अपने असली background के बारे में 4–5 sentences में बोलकर दीजिए: आपका role और experience, आपकी current company, मुख्य skills, और आगे आपका goal।
